description:
This is a Notice of Intent to Sole Source announcement only. This is not a request for formal proposals or quotes. Any responses to this announcement will be treated as information only. No entitlement to payment of direct or indirect costs or charges by the Government will arise as a result of contractor submission of responses to this announcement or the Government use of such information.
Purpose and Objectives:
VISN 10, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 10, is issuing a notice of intent to pursue a non-competitive procurement with Buffalo Supply Inc., Small Business, for emergency lighting repair at the Battle Creek VA Medical Center. The Buffalo Supply Inc. has met the suitability criteria, as determined in accordance 41 USC 1901, is implemented by FAR 13.106-1(b)(2), and the anticipated contract action is hereby publicized in accordance with FAR 5.101 and 5.203.
The purpose of this notification is to communicate the Governments intent to solicit and award a non-competitive procurement for Indianapolis EMR Integration Installation for the VAMC. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR TECHNICAL OR COST PROPOSALS OR QUOTES.
The VAMC requires a base year and no option years. 
Principal NAICS Code: 811210   Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance
Size Standards - $34 Million
Product or Service Code   J065   Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment   Medical, Dental, and Veterinary Equipment and Supplies
This non-competitive award is implemented by FAR 13.106-1(b)(2), as it is the only contractor that meets the suitability criteria as listed in the Statement of Work (SOW). The Government intends to procure this sole source requirement under FAR Parts 12, and 13.
THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES. All information received will be considered solely for determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. 
A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based upon responses received as a result of this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.
Places of Performance:
Battle Creek VA Medical Center
5500 Armstrong Rd.
Battle Creek, MI 49037
